Harmanpreet Kaur captains 150th T20 International, a first

Harmanpreet Kaur captained her 150th T20 International match during the Women's Asia Cup against Pakistan, becoming the first cricketer of any gender to lead a side in 150 T20Is. The milestone was recorded on the day of the match. Her 150 matches as captain are the most by any Indian player in women's T20Is, with the next highest being Mithali Raj's 32. Across both men's and women's T20Is, the second‑most matches as captain belong to MS Dhoni, who has led 72 times. Kaur said she enjoys playing cricket more than counting records, and the achievement was highlighted by multiple Indian media outlets.
